narrative.overview:
The selected third visual direction treats Schlossberghotel as a welcoming base within Greiz. A dark evergreen city map gives the place a strong first impression; the warm paper header and open reading sections make practical hotel information easy to find. The map is an interpretive illustration, clearly labeled as not to scale. It must not imply that the hotel itself is a castle or a protected landmark.

The same guide grammar runs through home, hotel, rooms, events, town and contact pages in German and English. A compact hotel logo area, clear route names, direct booking actions, precise facts and thin rules do most of the work. Generated interior imagery is disclosed as illustrative until approved hotel photography is available.
dos: Do keep booking pointed at the existing booking engine and event enquiries addressed to the published hotel email.
Do preserve the supplied original logo; all additional imagery must be new and its illustrative status clear.
Do provide visible keyboard focus, touch targets of at least 44px, and a reduced-motion path.
Do use only verified room, event, contact and arrival facts.
donts: Don't imply that generated imagery depicts actual hotel rooms or event spaces.
Don't claim exact walking distances, event guest capacities, room prices, guest reviews, or unverified architectural history.
Don't mix the superseded guestbook direction into this selected city-guide world.
